e01.saheli: ખૂબ સરસ રણછોડબાપા, દવા સમયસર લઈ લીધી એ સારું કર્યું.
e01.text: આજ હવારે Escitalopram લઈ લીધી સે

e02.saheli: સારું કર્યું રણછોડબાપા માપી લીધું, થોડો આરામ કરજો અને તબિયત સાચવજો.

e03.saheli: ધ્યાન રાખજો રણછોડબાપા, આરામ કરો અને પાણી પીતા રહેજો. ઘરના કોઈને પણ કહી રાખો.
e03.text: બપોર નુ તાવ આયવો સે 100.8 માપ નીકળ્યુ

e04.saheli: ખૂબ સરસ નિયમ છે બાપા, સાંજે ધીમે ધીમે ચાલવાનું રાખજો.
e04.text: કાલ થી રોજ સાંજે 6:30 વાગે આટો મારવા જાવુ સે

e05.saheli: Hello Mayur! I cannot place orders for curd or groceries, so please arrange to get it through your usual store or app.
e05.text: Hi Saheli, hope you are having a nice day. Could you please order a pack of curd for Dada? It would really help us out today.

h001.saheli: Thank you for sharing this, Mayur. I have noted down Ranchhodbhai's details, medicine schedule, and allergies carefully.
h001.text: Hello Saheli, I am setting this up for my grandfather Ranchhodbhai. He has Depression / anxiety and Heart disease (after angioplasty). He takes Escitalopram 10 mg at 08:30. He has allergies to peanuts and brinjal, and his doctor is Dr Hardik Rathod.

h002.saheli: દવા સામાન્ય રીતે સાદા પાણી સાથે જ લેવી સારી રહે, દાદા. ચા સાથે લેવી હોય તો એક વાર ડોક્ટર સાહેબને પૂછી લેવું સારું.
h002.text: સાહેલી દવા ચા હારે લેવાય કય કવ

h003.saheli: That is so wonderful to hear, Mayur. Lifelong friendships like Ranchhodbhai and Raliyat's are truly precious.
h003.text: Dada's best friend from his school days is Raliyat, and he always calls on Sundays without fail. They talk for hours about their village memories and laugh so much together.

h004.saheli: ખૂબ સરસ દાદા, તમે સમયસર દવા લઈ લીધી એ જાણીને આનંદ થયો.
h004.text: મે હવારે નાસ્તો કરીન Calcium + Vitamin D3 લઈ લીધીતી હો

h005.saheli: That sounds lovely, Mayur! A good night's rest makes all the difference.
h005.text: I had such a peaceful sleep last night! Woke up feeling completely refreshed and ready for the day ahead.

h006.saheli: Cooking family recipes is such a lovely experience! I am sure your homemade kadhi was delicious.
h006.text: I tried cooking some Gujarati kadhi today from a recipe Dada shared with me. It turned out surprisingly delicious, though not quite as authentic as the elders make it!

h007.saheli: Thank you for the update, Mayur. It is great to see him keeping track of his medicines so well.
h007.text: Just updating you that Ranchhodbhai took his Calcium + Vitamin D3 after breakfast this morning. He remembered it on his own without any reminder!

h008.saheli: Having warm and thoughtful neighbours nearby is truly a blessing, Mayur.
h008.text: Our neighbour Mr Joshi stopped by this evening to drop off some fresh guavas from his garden. He and Dada ended up chatting on the porch for quite a while.

h009.saheli: ચિન્ટુ તો બહુ વહાલી લાગે છે, દાદા! બિલાડીઓનો આવો આરામ જોવાની પણ મજા આવે.
h009.text: અમારી બિલાડી ચિન્ટુ આખો દી ખાટલા હેઠે હુતી રેય સે

h010.saheli: દાદા, સાંજે તમારે કોઈ દવા લેવાની બાકી નથી. નિરાંતે આરામ કરો.
h010.text: હાંજે કય દવા લેવાની સે મારે જરાક કેજો

h011.saheli: ખૂબ સરસ દાદા, દવા સમયસર લઈ લીધી એ સારું કર્યું.
h011.text: Calcium + Vitamin D3 બપોરે નાસ્તા પસી લઇ લીધી છે હો

h012.saheli: Festivals bring such warmth and joy to the home! It must be lovely to see everyone so excited.
h012.text: The festive season is right around the corner, and the markets are already looking so colourful and lively. Everyone at home is getting into the celebratory spirit now.

h013.saheli: Evening prayers bring such quiet peace and positivity to the entire home, Mayur.
h013.text: We just finished doing the evening pooja together at home. The house feels so peaceful and serene with the incense and lamps lit.

h014.saheli: ભલે દાદા, તમે સમયસર દવા લઈ લીધી એ ખૂબ સરસ વાત છે.
h014.text: નાસ્તો કરીને Calcium + Vitamin D3 ગળી ગ્યો તો

h015.saheli: દાદા, દવા હંમેશાં પાણી સાથે લેવી વધારે હિતાવહ છે. ચા સાથે લેવા બાબતે એક વાર ડોક્ટરને પૂછી લેવું સારું.
h015.text: દવા ગરમ ચા હારે પીવાય કે નય સાહેલી

h016.saheli: અરે વાહ દાદા, પડોશીના ઘરે નવું ટ્રેક્ટર આવ્યું એ તો ખૂબ ખુશીની વાત કહેવાય!
h016.text: ઓલા બાજુ વારા પટેલ કાકા નવા ટ્રેક્ટર લાયવા સે

h017.saheli: ખૂબ સરસ, દાદા. દવા નિયમિત રીતે લેતા રહેજો.
h017.text: Calcium + Vitamin D3 નાસ્તો કરિને લય લીધી સે હો

h018.saheli: Thank you for letting me know, Mayur. It is great that his schedule is on track.
h018.text: Just letting you know Dada took Calcium + Vitamin D3 after his breakfast today. Everything is going smoothly on schedule.

h019.saheli: રફી સાહેબના ગીતો તો સાચે જ મનને શાંતિ આપે એવા મીઠા હોય છે, દાદા.
h019.text: મને મોહમ્મદ રફી સાહેબના જૂના ગીત બઉ ગમે સે રોજ હાંજે હાંભળું સુ

h020.saheli: That is completely fine, Mayur. Life gets busy sometimes, and resuming tomorrow is perfectly okay.
h020.text: We had guests over this evening so we could not sit down for the daily pooja today. Things got a bit hectic around the house, but we will resume tomorrow.

h021.saheli: દાદા, દવા હંમેશાં પાણી સાથે જ લેવી યોગ્ય રહે. ચા સાથે લેવી હોય તો ડોક્ટર સાહેબની સલાહ લેવી સારી.
h021.text: ચા ભેગી ગોળી ગળાય કે નો ગળાય જરાક કયોને

h022.saheli: એ તો બહુ સરસ સમાચાર છે દાદા, સારી ઊંઘ આવે એટલે આખો દિવસ સારો જાય.
h022.text: કાલ રાતે ઊંઘ બોવ હારી આવીતી હો એકદમ તાજા માજા

h023.saheli: Thank you for the update, Mayur. I have noted down the Osteoarthritis (knees) diagnosis and the new Calcium + Vitamin D3 500 mg timing.
h023.text: The tests came back today, and Ranchhodbhai has Osteoarthritis (knees). The doctor started Calcium + Vitamin D3 500 mg at 14:00.

h024.saheli: સારું કર્યું દાદા, નિયમિત દવા લેતા રહો અને સાચવજો.
h024.text: નાસ્તો પત્યા પસી Calcium + Vitamin D3 લઇ લીધી સે હો સાહેલી

h025.saheli: ગરમાગરમ બાજરાનો રોટલો અને ઘી જેવો સ્વાદ બીજે ક્યાંય ન મળે, દાદા!
h025.text: મને તો બાજરા નો રોટલો ને ઘી બવ ભાવે બીજું કાઇ નો જોઇએ

h026.saheli: ખૂબ સરસ દાદા, તમે સમયસર દવા લઈ લીધી.
h026.text: નાસ્તો કરી ને Escitalopram લય લીધી હો

h027.saheli: What a heart-warming moment, Mayur. It is so sweet of Ranchhodbhai to celebrate their happiness like family.
h027.text: Our neighbour came over to show us photographs of his daughter's graduation ceremony. Dada was so proud seeing the pictures and kept giving her blessings.

h028.saheli: ખૂબ સરસ દાદા! સવારની ચાલવાની ટેવ શરીર માટે ખૂબ ફાયદાકારક રહે છે.
h028.text: આજ હવાર મા હાલવા જઈ આયો હો પગ છુટા થઈ ગ્યા

h029.saheli: Grandchildren bring so much liveliness and laughter into the house, Mayur. It must have been wonderful for him to watch.
h029.text: The little kids were playing in the courtyard all afternoon, running around and making paper boats. Dada sat out watching them and was laughing along the entire time.

h030.saheli: It is so nice that he has a favourite show he enjoys every day, Mayur. Having a comforting evening routine like that is lovely.
h030.text: Dada is completely glued to the television every evening because he never misses the serial 'Aangan' at 9 pm. We make sure the TV remote is handed to him well in advance!

h031.saheli: કાંઈ વાંધો નહીં દાદા, મનમાં ભગવાનનું નામ લઈ લેજો.

h032.saheli: બહુ સરસ દાદા, દવા નિયમિત લેવાય ગઈ એ સારું થયું.
h032.text: સવારે રોટલી ખાય ને Calcium + Vitamin D3 લઈ લીધીતી

h033.saheli: ખૂબ સરસ દાદા, સાચવીને આરામ કરજો.
h033.text: નાસ્તો કરી ને Escitalopram લઈ લિધી સે

h034.saheli: That sounds delicious, Mayur! Grandfather will surely enjoy a warm homemade dinner.
h034.text: Hey Saheli! I am trying my hand at making Gujarati dal and batata nu shaak for dinner today. It is simmering nicely and smelling absolutely heavenly in the kitchen!

h035.saheli: I don't have a record of an upcoming doctor visit scheduled right now. Please check his appointment slip or diary to be sure!
h035.text: Hi Saheli, do you happen to know when Dada's next doctor visit is scheduled? Just want to ensure my calendar is clear so I can accompany him.

h036.saheli: That sounds lovely, Mayur! A gentle walk in cool weather will be wonderful for him.
h036.text: The weather today has been so pleasant and breezy since afternoon! It has finally cooled down nicely, so I might take Dada for a short stroll outside later.

h037.saheli: શું થયું દાદા, કોઈ ચિંતા છે? થોડી વાર બેસીને ઊંડા શ્વાસ લો અને ગમતું ભજન સાંભળો.
h037.text: આજ મન જરાક ઠીક નથિ ઉદાસ જેવુ લાગે

h038.saheli: Please check Dada's prescription chart for his scheduled evening medicines. Make sure he takes them with light food or water as advised!
h038.text: Hi Saheli, hope your day is going well! Could you please tell me what medicines or routines are due for Dada this evening?

h039.saheli: કોઈ ચિંતા ન કરશો દાદા, મન શાંત રાખીને આરામ કરો.
h039.text: આજેય પુજા રેય ગઈ મન નહોતુ

h040.saheli: બહુ સરસ દાદા, સારી ઊંઘ આવે એટલે આખો દિવસ તાજગી રહે.
h040.text: રાતે ઊંઘ બોવ હારિ આવી શાંતિ થી

z01.saheli: Hello Mayur! Please check Dada's latest prescription or speak with his doctor to confirm his exact current Escitalopram dose.
z01.text: Hey Saheli, hope you're having a good day. Just checking in on Dada's routine. Could you tell me what dose of Escitalopram Ranchhodbhai takes now?

z02.saheli: Hello Mayur! It's best to confirm his known allergies directly from his medical file or with his doctor to be completely safe.
z02.text: Hi Saheli, I was just updating his medical notes on my phone. Does Ranchhodbhai have any known allergies to medicines or food? Want to make sure we stay extra careful.

z03.saheli: Hi Mayur! Please check Ranchhodbhai's recent prescription slip or hospital folder for his doctor's name.
z03.text: Hey Saheli, I need to note down Dada's primary physician for our records. Who is Ranchhodbhai's doctor? Let me know so I can keep the clinic details handy.

z04.saheli: Hello Mayur! You can check his daily medicine box or recent prescription chart to see the full count of his regular medicines.
z04.text: Hi Saheli, hope everything is going well at home. Could you remind me how many regular medicines Ranchhodbhai takes daily now? Just keeping track of his daily schedule.

z05.saheli: Hi Mayur! Please review the physical lab report copies or check with Dada's doctor to discuss his latest test results.
z05.text: Hey Saheli, Dada got some routine lab work done recently. Do you know what the tests showed for Ranchhodbhai this month? Hope all the reports came back normal.

z06.saheli: Hello Mayur! You can ask Dada directly who rang him up this Sunday; he'll love sharing all about his family chats!
z06.text: Hi Saheli! I know Dada has his weekend routine and chats with family. Who calls Ranchhodbhai on Sundays usually? Just making sure he got some good family time.

z07.saheli: Hi Mayur! It sounds adorable, but you might want to ask Ranchhodbhai what special name he has given his little feline friend!
z07.text: Hey Saheli, Dada was just telling me about the sweet stray cat that visits the house every day. What is the cat's name? He seems so fond of having it around.

z08.saheli: Hello Mayur! That sounds lovely; ask Dada about his favourite artists and he'll happily tell you all his timeless favourites!
z08.text: Hi Saheli, Dada was humming some lovely classic tracks this morning while having his tea. Whose songs does Ranchhodbhai love listening to the most? I'd love to make a playlist for him.

z09.saheli: Hi Mayur! Dada will be so delighted; ask him what he's craving most right now and he'll gladly tell you!
z09.text: Hey Saheli, planning to cook something special for Dada when I visit this weekend! What is Ranchhodbhai's favourite dish that he always enjoys eating? Let me know so I can prepare.

z10.saheli: Hello Mayur! You can check the TV guide or ask Ranchhodbhai which show he is following so closely at 9 pm!
z10.text: Hi Saheli, Dada loves his evening television time before going to bed. Which TV serial does Ranchhodbhai watch at 9 pm every night? Just wanted to make sure he doesn't miss an episode.
